entities.name: Sarusin
entities.description: A seasoned Dimir agent and mage whose mind is being overwritten by the memories of an excisor.

entities.name: Dimir
entities.description: Guild Sarusin serves as an agent.

entities.name: Mirko Vosk
entities.description: Vampire who excised Sarusin's memory of the chamber and poured an excisor's memories into him.

entities.name: Excisor
entities.description: Dimir excisor whose obsessed, power-hungry memories and identity take over Sarusin.

events.summary: Sarusin awakes in an unfamiliar underground chamber; Mirko had excised his memory of it and says he will teach him a method of acquiring memories.
events.quote: the vampire Mirko Vosk had excised a piece of his memories, the location of that particular chamber

events.summary: Mirko pours the excisor's memories into Sarusin, who loses track of which memories are his own.
events.quote: Mirko poured the excisor's memories into him.

events.summary: Sarusin uses the technique on a victim, but the other entity slips back into his memories and a stronger identity forms.
events.quote: He could feel the dam of his mind weakening under the pressure of a new, more powerful identity forming in his mind.

relations.quote: Sarusin is a seasoned Dimir agent and mage
